name: Segment white matter tracts using pyAFQ
summary: Segments a whole-brain tractogram into the 20 AFQ major white matter tracts with pyAFQ 0.4.1, registering DWI to MNI and using Mori-atlas waypoint ROIs, and outputs a white matter classification.
description: Registers the DWI b0 to the MNI152NLin2009cAsym T2w template (optionally affine first, then SyN), builds the AFQ bundle dictionary of waypoint ROIs, and runs pyAFQ segmentation on the tractogram. Outputs a classification structure with the names and streamline indices of the AFQ tracts, plus FreeSurfer surfaces for visualisation. DWI and tractogram must be in the same space.

inputs.description: The path to the top directory of the Freesurfer datatype. This is used for the visualization.
The path to the whole-brain tractogram to be segmented.
The path to the DWI datatype used to generate the whole-brain tractogram.

outputs.description: The AFQ classification structure including a classification.mat structure that contains the streamline indices in the whole-brain tractogram.

parameters.description: If true, will first align the DWI to the MNI template using an affine registration before computing the non-linear warp. However, if this has already been done, the non-linear warp should work just fine and this can be set to false

failure_modes.cause: No FreeSurfer license available in the environment.
failure_modes.fix: Set the FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable (provided automatically on brainlife.io).
